name: hud_ui_widget_invalidate_rect
description: HudUiWidget::InvalidateRect copies and clips a dirty rectangle into the first free dirty slot, transforms it through the widget center, and invalidates the widget.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The source intentionally preserves the original right-edge clamp mixup where imageRight is assigned to srcBottom instead of srcRight.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x4b3e90 show the null-image and no-free-slot early returns, first-free dirty slot selection, dirty-rect copy, x/top/bottom clipping, original right-edge clamp mixup, dirtyRectCount increment, two-frame invalidate-mask path, center-relative source rect transform, and final virtual Invalidate dispatch.

The native HUD smoke verifies first free slot use, mask 0x0c two-frame lifetime, draw origin capture, two GetCenterX/GetCenterY dispatches, final Invalidate dispatch, and the preserved right-edge clamp mixup.
